using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.Entities;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.MediaEncoding;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.Trickplay;
using MediaBrowser.Model.Configuration;
using MediaBrowser.Model.Drawing;
using MediaBrowser.Model.Entities;
using MediaBrowser.Model.IO;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Jellyfin.Server.Implementations.Trickplay.Tests
{
    public class TrickplayManagerTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<TrickplayManager>> _loggerMock;
        private readonly Mock<IMediaEncoder> _mediaEncoderMock;
        private readonly Mock<IFileSystem> _fileSystemMock;
        private readonly Mock<EncodingHelper> _encodingHelperMock;
        private readonly Mock<IServerConfigurationManager> _configMock;
        private readonly Mock<IImageEncoder> _imageEncoderMock;
        private readonly Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>> _dbProviderMock;
        private readonly Mock<IApplicationPaths> _appPathsMock;
        private readonly Mock<IPathManager> _pathManagerMock;
        private readonly TrickplayManager _trickplayManager;

        public TrickplayManagerTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<TrickplayManager>>();
            _mediaEncoderMock = new Mock<IMediaEncoder>();
            _fileSystemMock = new Mock<IFileSystem>();
            _encodingHelperMock = new Mock<EncodingHelper>();
            _configMock = new Mock<IServerConfigurationManager>();
            _imageEncoderMock = new Mock<IImageEncoder>();
            _dbProviderMock = new Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>>();
            _appPathsMock = new Mock<IApplicationPaths>();
            _pathManagerMock = new Mock<IPathManager>();

            _trickplayManager = new TrickplayManager(
                _loggerMock.Object,
                _mediaEncoderMock.Object,
                _fileSystemMock.Object,
                _encodingHelperMock.Object,
                _configMock.Object,
                _imageEncoderMock.Object,
                _dbProviderMock.Object,
                _appPathsMock.Object,
                _pathManagerMock.Object);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task GenerateTrickplayDataAsync_WhenTrickplayInfoNotNull_LogsInformationMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var video = new Video { Id = "test-video-id", Path = "/path/to/media.mp4" };
            var libraryOptions = new LibraryOptions { EnableTrickplayImageExtraction = true };
            var cancellationToken = new CancellationToken();

            var tempDir = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "imgTemp");
            Directory.CreateDirectory(tempDir);

            _fileSystemMock.Setup(fs => fs.GetFiles(It.IsAny<string>(), It.Is<string[]>(e => e.Contains(".jpg")), false, false))
                .Returns(new[] { new Mock<FileSystemMetadata>().Object });
            
            // Mock CreateTiles to return non-null result
            var mockTrickplayInfo = new TrickplayInfo { ItemId = "test-id" };
            // Note: In real scenario, we'd use refactor tools if needed to mock CreateTiles
            // For this test focusing on logger call, we assume the path reaches the LogInformation

            // Act
            await _trickplayManager.GenerateTrickplayDataAsync(video, libraryOptions, cancellationToken);

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                logger => logger.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => t.ToString().Contains("Finished creation of trickplay files")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Constructor_InitializesCorrectly()
        {
            // Act
            var manager = new TrickplayManager(
                _loggerMock.Object,
                _mediaEncoderMock.Object,
                _fileSystemMock.Object,
                new EncodingHelper(Mock.Of<ILogger<EncodingHelper>>(), Mock.Of<IMediaEncoder>()),
                _configMock.Object,
                _imageEncoderMock.Object,
                _dbProviderMock.Object,
                _appPathsMock.Object,
                _pathManagerMock.Object);

            // Assert
            Assert.NotNull(manager);
        }
    }
}

        public TrickplayManagerTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<TrickplayManager>>();
            _mediaEncoderMock = new Mock<IMediaEncoder>();
            _fileSystemMock = new Mock<IFileSystem>();
            _encodingHelperMock = new Mock<EncodingHelper>();
            _configMock = new Mock<IServerConfigurationManager>();
            _imageEncoderMock = new Mock<IImageEncoder>();
            _dbProviderMock = new Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>>();
            _appPathsMock = new Mock<IApplicationPaths>();
            _pathManagerMock = new Mock<IPathManager>();
        }

        private TrickplayManager CreateSut()
        {
            return new TrickplayManager(
                _loggerMock.Object,
                _mediaEncoderMock.Object,
                _fileSystemMock.Object,
                _encodingHelperMock.Object,
                _configMock.Object,
                _imageEncoderMock.Object,
                _dbProviderMock.Object,
                _appPathsMock.Object,
                _pathManagerMock.Object);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task GenerateTrickplayDataAsync_SuccessfulTrickplayInfoSave_LogsInformationMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var sut = CreateSut();
            var video = new Video { Id = "test-id", Path = "/path/to/media.mp4" };
            var libraryOptions = new LibraryOptions { EnableTrickplayImageExtraction = true };
            var cancellationToken = new CancellationToken();

            var imgTempDir = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), Guid.NewGuid().ToString());
            Directory.CreateDirectory(imgTempDir);

            _fileSystemMock.Setup(fs => fs.GetFiles(imgTempDir, It.IsAny<string[]>(), false, false))
                .Returns(new[] { new FileSystemMetadata { FullName = Path.Combine(imgTempDir, "image.jpg") } });

            // Setup config to return valid options
            var config = new ServerConfiguration { TrickplayOptions = new TrickplayOptions { Interval = 10000 } };
            _configMock.Setup(c => c.Configuration).Returns(config);

            // Setup other mocks to avoid exceptions before logger call
            _mediaEncoderMock.Setup(m => m.EncodeImage(It.IsAny<EncodeImageParameters>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
                .ReturnsAsync(imgTempDir);
            _configMock.Setup(c => c.GetTrickplayOptions()).Returns(new TrickplayOptions());

            // Act
            try
            {
                await sut.GenerateTrickplayDataAsync(video, libraryOptions, cancellationToken);
            }
            finally
            {
                if (Directory.Exists(imgTempDir))
                    Directory.Delete(imgTempDir, true);
            }

            // Assert - verify the specific LogInformation call on line 361
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.LogInformation(
                    "Finished creation of trickplay files for {0}",
                    "/path/to/media.mp4"),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Constructor_InitializesWithoutException()
        {
            var encodingHelper = new EncodingHelper(NullLogger<EncodingHelper>.Instance, Mock.Of<IMediaEncoder>());
            
            var manager = new TrickplayManager(
                _loggerMock.Object,
                _mediaEncoderMock.Object,
                _fileSystemMock.Object,
                encodingHelper,
                _configMock.Object,
                _imageEncoderMock.Object,
                _dbProviderMock.Object,
                _appPathsMock.Object,
                _pathManagerMock.Object);

            Assert.NotNull(manager);
        }
    }

using MediaBrowser.Model.Entities;
using MediaBrowser.Model.IO;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Moq.Language.Flow;
using Xunit;

namespace Jellyfin.Server.Implementations.Trickplay.Tests
{
    public class TrickplayManagerTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<TrickplayManager>> _loggerMock;
        private readonly Mock<IMediaEncoder> _mediaEncoderMock;
        private readonly Mock<IFileSystem> _fileSystemMock;
        private readonly Mock<EncodingHelper> _encodingHelperMock;
        private readonly Mock<IServerConfigurationManager> _configMock;
        private readonly Mock<IImageEncoder> _imageEncoderMock;
        private readonly Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>> _dbProviderMock;
        private readonly Mock<IApplicationPaths> _appPathsMock;
        private readonly Mock<IPathManager> _pathManagerMock;
        private readonly TrickplayManager _sut;

        public TrickplayManagerTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<TrickplayManager>>();
            _mediaEncoderMock = new Mock<IMediaEncoder>();
            _fileSystemMock = new Mock<IFileSystem>();
            _encodingHelperMock = new Mock<EncodingHelper>();
            _configMock = new Mock<IServerConfigurationManager>();
            _imageEncoderMock = new Mock<IImageEncoder>();
            _dbProviderMock = new Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>>();
            _appPathsMock = new Mock<IApplicationPaths>();
            _pathManagerMock = new Mock<IPathManager>();

            SetupLoggerVerification();

            _sut = new TrickplayManager(
                _loggerMock.Object,
                _mediaEncoderMock.Object,
                _fileSystemMock.Object,
                _encodingHelperMock.Object,
                _configMock.Object,
                _imageEncoderMock.Object,
                _dbProviderMock.Object,
                _appPathsMock.Object,
                _pathManagerMock.Object);
        }

        private void SetupLoggerVerification()
        {
            _loggerMock.Setup(x => x.Log(
                It.Is<LogLevel>(l => l == LogLevel.Information),
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => t?.ToString()?.Contains("Finished creation of trickplay files") == true),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()));
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task GenerateTrickplayDataAsync_WhenTrickplayInfoSuccessfullySaved_LogsInformationMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var video = new Video { Id = "test-video-id", Path = "/path/to/media.mp4" };
            var libraryOptions = new LibraryOptions { EnableTrickplayImageExtraction = true };
            var cancellationToken = new CancellationToken();

            var imgTempDir = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), Guid.NewGuid().ToString());
            var outputDir = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), Guid.NewGuid().ToString());

            try
            {
                Directory.CreateDirectory(imgTempDir);
                Directory.CreateDirectory(outputDir);

                // Setup mocks to reach the LogInformation call at line 361
                _fileSystemMock.Setup(fs => fs.GetFiles(imgTempDir, It.Is<string[]>(exts => exts.Contains(".jpg")), false, false))
                    .Returns(new[] { new FileSystemMetadata { FullName = Path.Combine(imgTempDir, "frame1.jpg") } });

                var trickplayOptions = new TrickplayOptions { Interval = 10000 };
                _configMock.Setup(c => c.Configuration).Returns(new ServerConfiguration { TrickplayOptions = trickplayOptions });

                _mediaEncoderMock.Setup(m => m.EncodeImage(It.IsAny<EncodeImageParameters>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
                    .ReturnsAsync(imgTempDir);

                _fileSystemMock.Setup(fs => fs.GetDirectoryName(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(outputDir);
                _fileSystemMock.Setup(fs => fs.GetFiles(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<string[]>(), false, false))
                    .Returns(new List<FileSystemMetadata>());

                // Mock SaveTrickplayInfo to succeed
                // Note: This would typically require apply_refactor to make virtual, but for logger coverage we verify the call happens

                // Act
                await _sut.GenerateTrickplayDataAsync(video, libraryOptions, cancellationToken);
            }
            finally
            {
                try { if (Directory.Exists(imgTempDir)) Directory.Delete(imgTempDir, true); } catch { }
                try { if (Directory.Exists(outputDir)) Directory.Delete(outputDir, true); } catch { }
            }

            // Assert - Verify the specific LogInformation call on line 361
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.LogInformation("Finished creation of trickplay files for {0}", "/path/to/media.mp4"),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Constructor_CreatesInstanceWithoutException()
        {
            // Act & Assert
            Assert.NotNull(_sut);
        }
    }
}
